comment: Every `content_hash` in signoff/block-manifest.json pins the artifact the cited envelope *describes* (its own `provenance.input.content_hash`), not the envelope file. `klt signoff` cannot re-hash that artifact -- it only compares the manifest pin against the hash the envelope recorded, so both sides can agree while the artifact on disk has moved on (citation.input_verified is null on every row). This file names, per pinned citation, where that artifact lives in this repo, so scripts/ci/check_signoff_pins.py can re-hash it. Issue #292; see signoff/README.md.

a `klt yield` report carries no `provenance` block at all, so `klt signoff` hashes the sample-set document the report names in its own top-level `samples` field and uses that as the citation's input hash -- this is that document. It is therefore also the one pin whose `describes` path must stay identical to the cited envelope's `samples` value: issue #288 made that value repo-relative (it used to be an absolute, machine-local path, which is why this item could not be cited at all), and sim/tests/test_emit_klt_yield.py guards it.
